screening_decisions.reason: Not a randomized controlled trial; it is a review/discussion article.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of prednisolone 7.5 mg vs placebo; evaluates radiographic progression of hands (Larsen index). Meets all selection criteria.
This is a systematic review (Cochrane), not a primary randomized controlled trial.

Randomized controlled trial (COBRA) comparing combined step-down prednisolone, methotrexate, sulfasalazine vs sulfasalazine alone; evaluates radiographic damage in hands and feet (Sharp/Van der Heijde). Meets criteria.

Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of prednisone 10 mg/day vs placebo; includes radiologic studies every 6 months. Meets criteria for population, intervention, comparison, and radiographic outcome.
Randomized controlled trial of intramuscular depomedrone (methylprednisolone, a glucocorticoid) vs placebo; x-ray examination of hands and feet scored by Larsen's method. Meets criteria.
Narrative review of efficacy and safety; not a randomized controlled trial.
Discussion article on feasibility of a trial; not a trial itself.
Non-randomized long-term follow-up of the COBRA trial; not a new randomized controlled trial (no treatment protocol, observational follow-up).
Systematic review of randomized placebo-controlled trials; not a primary trial.
Two-year randomized trial of low-dose prednisolone added to initial DMARD vs no prednisolone; evaluates radiographs of hands and feet (Sharp/van der Heijde). Meets criteria.
Review/report on corticosteroids; not a randomized controlled trial.
Double-blind placebo-controlled trial of low-dose prednisolone 7 mg/day vs placebo in patients on DMARDs; radiological damage assessed by modified Sharp method. Meets criteria.
Observational study of drug continuation in private practices; not a randomized trial.
Randomized trial of methotrexate alone vs methotrexate plus prednisolone (≥10 mg/day); evaluates radiographs of hand and foot joints (Larsen). Meets criteria.
Survey of prescribing practices and chart review; not a trial.
Review article on safety of low-dose glucocorticoids; not a primary trial.
Double-blind study of prednisone 5 mg/day vs placebo in patients on other drugs; assessed progression of hand erosions. Meets criteria for a randomized controlled trial with radiographic outcome.
Double-blind placebo-controlled trial of intravenous methylprednisolone pulses vs placebo combined with DMARDs; radiography to determine erosions. Meets criteria.
Secondary analysis of data from a randomized trial; not a separate randomized controlled trial itself.

Randomized controlled trial (BeST study) comparing four treatment strategies, one including high-dose prednisone tapered; evaluates radiographic joint damage (Sharp/Van der Heijde) of hands and feet. Meets criteria.
Multicenter double-blind placebo-controlled trial of prednisolone 5 mg/day vs placebo with background DMARDs; evaluates hand and foot radiographs by Ratingen and Sharp scores. Meets criteria.
Meta-analysis of second-line drugs; not a primary randomized controlled trial.

Follow-up report of a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of prednisolone 7.5 mg daily, evaluating radiographic progression after treatment discontinuation; maintains original randomized groups and evaluates radiographs. Meets criteria.
Randomized trial of DMARD alone vs DMARD plus prednisolone (mean 6 mg/day); evaluates radiograph of hands (Larsen score). Meets criteria.
Review article on links between joint damage and disability; not a randomized controlled trial.
